title: The Live Contact
author: Y. M. Ashgrove
blurb: Beatrix Ravensworth, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
